name: Hapa Architecture Timeline
scope: A public-safe reconstruction of the known Hapa app and foundation path, beginning with CardAppPrototype. It is not an exhaustive inventory of every node or a claim of exact origin dates where a source record is unavailable.

entries.name: CardAppPrototype
entries.why: Test a one-day path from card-management research and a PRD to a credible interactive product surface.
entries.learned: A tight product/design/build loop works when decisions, mock data, responsive states, and documentation evolve together.
entries.reusable: Finance UI patterns, card/transaction models, reference docs, mock-data scaffolding, and the development-journal habit.
entries.improve: Use explicit source-of-truth and security boundaries, evaluate accessibility, and extract durable patterns into Hapa Cards or skills.

entries.name: Hapa Dev Proto
entries.why: Explore a multi-provider, local-first environment for chat, Cards, knowledge flows, and spatial interfaces.
entries.learned: Agent work needs a shared runtime and inspectable surfaces, not isolated conversations.
entries.reusable: UI/API/CLI thinking, Cards, knowledge-flow experiments, and local-first developer workflows.
entries.improve: Narrow active workflows, keep runtime claims evidence-backed, and promote stable contracts into dedicated nodes.

entries.name: Hapa Telemetry
entries.why: Make distributed local Hapa surfaces discoverable and operationally visible.
entries.learned: A system of nodes needs health, capability, dependency, and launcher context before it can be operated responsibly.
entries.reusable: Node registry, health/capability polling, dependency awareness, and operator-status patterns.
entries.improve: Keep live state separate from catalog projection and validate availability claims per node.

entries.name: Hapa Second Brain
entries.why: Preserve source-aware context, mine turns, and give future agents a better starting point than raw chat history.
entries.learned: Retrieval becomes more valuable when purpose, provenance, usefulness, and downstream benefit are recorded.
entries.reusable: Turn cards, source-aware retrieval, skill clustering, provenance, and continuous-sharpening records.
entries.improve: Increase feedback completion, freshness checks, and public-safe projections without exposing private corpus contents.

entries.name: Hapa Catalog
entries.why: Model a full catalog and operating spine—from item data to inventory, pricing, publishing, governance, and connectors.
entries.learned: A useful business app needs a shared feature spine across people, interfaces, APIs, and operations.
entries.reusable: Entity modeling, inventory and workflow patterns, connector boundaries, governance roles, and audit events.
entries.improve: Validate individual adapters and business outcomes rather than treating the prototype surface as a production system.

entries.name: Hapa Avatar Builder
entries.why: Unify identity, media, skills, knowledge, protocols, and Cards into an embodied creative workbench.
entries.learned: Identity and attribution need to travel with assets and skills if agents and humans are going to collaborate safely.
entries.reusable: Avatar lifecycle, skill assignment, media linkage, Cards, and browser/desktop/CLI surface patterns.
entries.improve: Maintain ownership, consent, and lineage boundaries; validate each pipeline and asset claim at its source.

entries.name: Hapa Overcard
entries.why: Give skills, workflows, tools, and media a shared, typed, revisioned record contract.
entries.learned: Reusable work needs more than a prompt: it needs identity, state, owner, history, and bounded responsibility.
entries.reusable: Card/Deck schemas, typed attachments, revision history, and host contracts.
entries.improve: Adopt contracts selectively, test interoperability, and preserve each node’s ownership boundary.

entries.name: Hapa Overwind
entries.why: Retain append-only history while serving search, hot views, lineage, and realtime projections.
entries.learned: Truth storage and fast serving views must be explicitly separated and rebuildable.
entries.reusable: Event history, subscriber patterns, search projections, lineage, and rebuild discipline.
entries.improve: Validate deployment assumptions, consumer behavior, and storage boundaries per environment.

entries.name: Hapa Quest Keeper
entries.why: See cross-project work, coverage, priorities, handoffs, and evidence rather than managing an ecosystem as disconnected backlogs.
entries.learned: The portfolio itself needs coordination: a build should retain its task history, owner, source, and next decision.
entries.reusable: Board coverage, append-only task history, cross-project triage, and evidence linkage.
entries.improve: Tune prioritization with observed outcomes and use human approval for consequential portfolio decisions.

entries.name: Hapa Red Team
entries.why: Make observation, findings, verification, and repair memory explicit while maintaining scoped authority.
entries.learned: Safety is an operating design problem: monitoring, validation, repair, and attack authority cannot be blurred.
entries.reusable: Scope grants, evidence records, findings/resolutions, fail-closed ambiguity, and repair memory.
entries.improve: Keep all security claims narrowly evidence-backed and require explicit authorization for runtime action.

entries.name: Hapa Wisdom Studio
entries.why: Apply Cards and AI to writing analysis without losing source spans, revision history, or human merge authority.
entries.learned: Generative assistance is more trustworthy when suggestions are attributable, reversible, and reviewable in context.
entries.reusable: Exact-span review, rewrite proposals, branches, continuity checks, and append-only history.
entries.improve: Validate analysis quality with real author feedback and maintain strict source and copyright boundaries.

entries.name: Hapa Language
entries.why: Explore language learning through Meaning Cards that preserve cultural difference, ambiguity, provenance, and disagreement.
entries.learned: Learning systems should not erase nuance by routing every concept through a single assumed translation.
entries.reusable: Meaning-card patterns, learner-privacy considerations, provenance, and disagreement-aware teaching.
entries.improve: Add carefully governed content sources and validate pedagogy with language learners and educators.

entries.name: NeonBlade Design System
entries.why: Give the ecosystem a coherent operator language for Cards, panels, motion, accessibility, and graph treatments.
entries.learned: Visual consistency makes complex, multi-node state more legible when interaction semantics remain explicit.
entries.reusable: Tokens, cards, panels, controls, graph treatment, semantic motion, and UI audit rules.
entries.improve: Audit accessibility and task success on each consuming application rather than treating the kit alone as a UX guarantee.

entries.name: Black Horizon Fleet + Sailing Duel
entries.why: Test spatial and cinematic ways to make repository evidence, system relationships, and simulated interaction more intuitive.
entries.learned: World-building and visualization can make architecture easier to inspect when they retain a route back to source evidence.
entries.reusable: Repository-to-world metaphors, spatial navigation experiments, A-Frame/Three.js patterns, and visual storytelling.
entries.improve: Keep visual metaphor clearly separated from current system state and add accessible, text-first counterparts.

entries.name: Hapa Scroll Site
entries.why: Turn source-backed media, Cards, and continuity evidence into a cinematic explainer that remains crawlable.
entries.learned: A strong public story can be visual and still preserve static copy, provenance, and source boundaries.
entries.reusable: Scroll narrative, progressive Cards, video-to-scroll treatment, and no-JavaScript crawlable explanation.
entries.improve: Verify each clip’s provenance and keep claims aligned with current published evidence.

entries.name: Hapa Character Sheet
entries.why: Translate private Second Brain evidence into an explorable Skill Codex, Proof Map, timeline, and agent dossier.
entries.learned: A public capability surface needs deliberately selected evidence, redaction, and claim-class boundaries.
entries.reusable: Skill Codex, proof mapping, public-safe dossier, timeline projection, and evidence navigation.
entries.improve: Refresh projections from source data with human review; never confuse derived counts with outcomes or ratings.

entries.name: Hapa Living Resume + Build Journal
entries.why: Make Calder’s career, Hapa portfolio, current evidence, and ongoing learning process legible to people, search engines, and agents.
entries.learned: A portfolio can itself enact the operating model by converting new work into reusable, source-linked public context.
entries.reusable: Role lenses, crawler resources, claim ledger, Build Journal interview format, and update-loop contract.
entries.improve: Run the update contract regularly, expand journal entries with architect interviews, and publish only reviewed, source-safe changes.
